name: pkm
description: Personal knowledge management across two services: clip a finished AI session into a PARA Obsidian vault, resolve that vault git pull conflicts, and add or classify URLs in Karakeep.

interface.shortDescription: Obsidian vault clips and Karakeep bookmark filing
interface.longDescription: PKM bundles the four skills that keep a personal knowledge base current. obsidian-session-clip writes one markdown note per finished AI session into the vault Inbox and commits just that file. obsidian-resolve-conflict diagnoses, classifies, resolves, commits, and pushes a vault git pull conflict without ever auto-merging a note body. karakeep-classify reads the live Karakeep List tree and proposes where a URL belongs, dry-run by default. karakeep-add performs the REST write, creating any missing List parents and deduplicating by URL. Both Karakeep skills need a reachable instance plus its API token; both Obsidian skills need a local git-backed vault.
defaultPrompt: Clip this session to my vault.
Where should this bookmark go in Karakeep?
